chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Within it is a gate from the gates of Paradise that has not been closed since it was opened."

key_terms.أَبْوَابِ: gates, indicating one among multiple entrances
key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise, the abode of divine reward
key_terms.فِيهِ: within it; referring to the matter being discussed

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean by saying there is a gate of Paradise that has never been closed?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام describes in this hadith a great virtue associated with the subject under discussion, indicating that it is linked to a gate of Paradise that remains open. The wording emphasizes ongoing divine favor and encourages devotion to this act of worship.
